# Wakeel.org

> Wakeel.org is an AI-powered legal assistant that helps citizens, law students, lawyers, and institutions understand legal information, analyze documents, and research law. Originally built around Pakistan's legal system, it now provides legal guidance for the GCC and 15+ countries worldwide. Ask questions in plain English or Urdu, analyze documents up to 100+ pages, and get source-aware legal guidance. Wakeel provides legal information and research support — it is not a substitute for a licensed advocate and does not provide final legal advice.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://wakeel.org/): Overview of Wakeel.org, its AI legal assistant capabilities, and who it serves.
- [About](https://wakeel.org/about): Why Wakeel.org exists, its approach, and what it does and does not replace.
- [Features](https://wakeel.org/features): AI legal chat, document analysis, legal research, drafting support, and professional workflows.
- [Pricing](https://wakeel.org/pricing): Free, Student, Professional, and Organization plans.
- [Legal Sources & Trust Framework](https://wakeel.org/legal-sources): How Wakeel uses sources, source-aware answers, and human verification requirements.
- [Legal Disclaimer](https://wakeel.org/disclaimer): Information-only scope, verification requirements, and lawyer-client boundaries.
- [Contact](https://wakeel.org/contact): Partnership, demo, organization access, and support inquiries.

## Who Wakeel serves

- [Citizens](https://wakeel.org/citizens): Understand legal rights, notices, and documents in simple English and Urdu.
- [Law Students](https://wakeel.org/law-students): Study support, case summaries, and legal research for Pakistani law.
- [Lawyers](https://wakeel.org/lawyers): Research, drafting, document review, and matter organization.
- [Law Firms](https://wakeel.org/law-firms): Shared research and document workflows for teams.
- [Judges](https://wakeel.org/judges): Neutral research aid for statutes, precedents, and document summaries.
- [Policymakers](https://wakeel.org/policymakers): Policy and regulation research support.
- [Legal Institutions](https://wakeel.org/legal-institutions): Education, legal aid, and research workflow support.

## Compare

- [Best AI Legal Apps in Pakistan](https://wakeel.org/best-ai-legal-apps-pakistan): Honest comparison of AI legal tools for Pakistani users and the criteria that matter (Pakistani-law grounding, Urdu support, document analysis, safety, free plans).
- [Will AI Replace Lawyers? AI vs Hiring a Lawyer](https://wakeel.org/ai-vs-lawyer-pakistan): What AI legal tools do well, what only a licensed advocate can do, and when to use each in Pakistan.
- [Can AI Replace a Lawyer for Pakistani Legal Questions?](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/can-ai-replace-a-lawyer-pakistan): A direct answer on whether AI can replace a lawyer in Pakistan, and what AI legal assistants are genuinely good for today.
- [When Should You Use an AI Legal Assistant Instead of a Lawyer?](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/when-to-use-ai-legal-assistant-vs-lawyer-pakistan): A practical checklist for when an AI legal assistant is enough, and when to see a licensed advocate first.
- [Best Legal Apps for Pakistani Citizens](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/best-legal-apps-pakistani-citizens): AI legal assistants, drafting tools, case trackers, and lawyer directories, and how to judge each category.

## Journal articles — practical legal how-tos

- [How to Register an FIR in Pakistan](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/how-to-register-fir-pakistan): FIR registration under Section 154 CrPC, what officers must legally do, and what to do if police refuse.
- [How to File a Consumer Complaint in Pakistan](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/consumer-complaint-pakistan): Provincial Consumer Protection Acts, evidence to collect, and how consumer courts actually work.
- [Tenant Rights Under Pakistan's Rent Laws](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/tenant-rights-rent-law-pakistan): Written agreements, protection from arbitrary eviction, rent rules, and landlord-tenant dispute resolution.
- [Common Family Law Rights in Pakistan](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/family-law-rights-pakistan): Khula, talaq, custody, maintenance, and haq mehr, grounded in the actual statutes and case law.
- [Understanding Legal Notices in Pakistan](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/understanding-legal-notices-pakistan): What a legal notice means, why lawyers send them, and how to respond properly and on time.
- [How to Understand a Legal Document Without a Lawyer](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/understand-legal-document-without-lawyer-pakistan): A step-by-step method for reading contracts and agreements, red flags to catch, and when to call a lawyer.
- [Pakistani Law vs Common Law: What's Different](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/pakistani-law-vs-common-law): How Pakistan's legal system inherited common law method, then diverged through codification and Islamic law review.
- [Wakeel AI for Law Students in Pakistan](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/wakeel-ai-for-law-students-pakistan): Statute explanations, case law research, bilingual study notes, and LGAT prep for LLB students.
- [AI Legal Research Tools for Lawyers in Pakistan](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/ai-legal-research-tools-lawyers-pakistan): How AI research and document review tools fit into a Pakistani lawyer's practice, and their real limits.
- [How to File a Civil Suit in Pakistan](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/civil-suit-pakistan): Jurisdiction, drafting the plaint, court fees, and a realistic timeline under the CPC 1908.
- [How to Draft a Legal Contract in Pakistan](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/draft-legal-contract-pakistan): The essential elements of an enforceable contract under the Contract Act 1872, and template risks.
- [Finding a Property Dispute Lawyer in Pakistan](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/property-dispute-lawyer-pakistan): How to vet and hire a property lawyer — bar council verification, experience checks, and red flags.
- [Using AI to Review Contracts in Pakistan](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/ai-contract-review-pakistan): What AI contract review does well, and where a lawyer's review is still required.
- [Property Transfer and Mutation Process in Pakistan](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/property-transfer-mutation-pakistan): Sale deed registration, stamp duty, and the mutation (intiqal) process explained.
- [How to File a Cyber Crime Complaint in Pakistan](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/nccia-cyber-crime-complaint-pakistan): Filing under PECA 2016, evidence to collect, and the FIA / NCCIA agency transition.
- [How to Register a Nikah Nama in Pakistan](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/nikah-nama-registration-pakistan): What the nikah nama records, who registers it, and the columns worth reading carefully.
- [Section 420 PPC: Fraud and Cheating in Pakistan](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/section-420-ppc-fraud-pakistan): What the section covers, its legal ingredients, and how it differs from a civil dispute.
- [NADRA Biometric Verification Issues in Pakistan](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/nadra-biometric-verification-pakistan): Why verification fails, SIM and bank account impacts, and how to resolve it.
- [The Exit Control List (ECL) in Pakistan](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/exit-control-list-ecl-pakistan): What the ECL is, who can place a name on it, and the removal process.
